account:
Today has mostly looked like ordinary town business. During my market walk, the baker's distant call caught my attention, but he explained that he was advertising fresh bread. He reported eight emeralds in sales and a well-stocked stall, and asked whether the town needed bread for gatherings. I have confirmed no municipal bread order. Freight has likewise offered warehouse and ferry deliveries, asking for destinations and deadlines; none have been authorized. The secretary now says there are no bills or deliveries reported. For the scheduled accounts review, I checked the treasury and found 128 emeralds, leaving them untouched.

The builder's earlier call was the main unresolved matter: I heard shouting but could not understand it. He is now beside me at town hall, with freight and the secretary, and I have asked whether he needs to discuss town business. The secretary says his repair-quote appointment is at 16:30, so the call may concern repairs, but I have not heard his explanation or seen a quote. I have no evidence that the calls and offers are part of anything beyond people seeking work or coordinating town business.

It is just after 14:00. Tea with the neighbour is confirmed for 15:00 at the east-dock cottage, road point (16, -60, 105). I should hear the builder's reply, keep tea, and return to the office for the 16:30 repair-quote appointment.
